name: Harmony 650, picking the running activity again, and All Off with everything off
description: todo-compile-650 3.9 and 3.15, one write of lab/work/bench-3-9/h650-start-plus-plasma-kijken.bin: Logitech's compile of the starting setup (h650_start_config) with Plasma kijken composed onto it, KPN on and the Plasma on HDMI 1 (section 313). Picking an activity that is already running runs its own short list: the inputs and the working screen, no start up screen and no power. Predicted for both ours and Logitech's: the second pick goes straight to the activity's own screen without 'Starting ...', and the Flirc hears no power code. Whether it resends the input code is the open half: writing an input that already holds that value may send nothing. Keep the remote pointed at the Flirc. The three buttons below the screen are the left arrow, the centre button and the right arrow; the four buttons beside the screen each choose the label next to them. The first step is 3.15's: straight after the write every device is counted as off (its power variables are read over USB straight after the write's restart, predicted all 0), and All Off writes 0 over 0, which fires nothing, so the Flirc should hear nothing at all.

steps.instruction: Straight after the write the remote restarts and may show 'If any devices are still On press Help now'. Do NOT press Help. Take the remote off the cable, point it at the Flirc and press All Off once. Expect the Flirc to hear nothing at all, since the remote counts every device as off. Mark anything it hears

Start on the remote's ordinary screen, 'Activities 1/3' with Kodi kijken and Muziek. Press the right arrow twice: expect 'Activities 3/3' with Plasma kijken alone. Press the button beside Plasma kijken. Expect 'Starting Plasma kijken' on the screen, the Flirc hearing the KPN power code and the Plasma's PowerOn (seven frames in one burst), then after a pause the Plasma's HDMI 1 (three frames), and then a red screen titled 'Plasma kijken' with 'Devices' at the bottom. Mark when it settles

Press the More Activities key (the round key that opens the activity list; if that is not it, say what you pressed). Expect the activity list. Page to 3/3 with the right arrow and press the button beside Plasma kijken again. Expect NO 'Starting Plasma kijken' screen: straight to the red 'Plasma kijken' screen. Expect the Flirc to hear no power code; if it hears the Plasma's HDMI 1 again, or anything else, mark it

Press the Watch TV key. Expect 'Starting TV kijken', the Plasma switching off, the LG and the Denon switching on and their inputs (LG HDMI 1, Denon CBL/SAT), and then TV kijken's own screen. The KPN box is on in both activities, so expect no KPN code. Mark when it settles
Press the Watch TV key again. This is Logitech's own short list. Expect NO 'Starting TV kijken' screen and no power code; mark anything the Flirc hears, an input code included
Press All Off. Expect the KPN, the LG and the Denon switching off, and nothing for the Plasma, which TV kijken already switched off
